errors.text: The central MTP-plus-free-energy-perturbation methodology is entirely replaced by an LSF-plus-SRO CALPHAD proposal.
The hypothesis treats magnetic fluctuations as a dominant melting contribution, whereas the target found their high-temperature effect negligible.
None of the cited evidence demonstrates improved melting temperature, entropy of fusion, or heat-capacity predictions from the proposed LSF-plus-SRO model.
The claimed accuracy of within ±50 K and the asserted >100 K baseline errors are unsupported by the cited studies.
The target alloy, TaVCrW, benchmark conditions, MTP training criterion, EAM/TI baseline, and computational-efficiency outcome are absent.
